method: Native ordinary game loop, 300 wall seconds, no time acceleration or forced path. Initial .24 cover is a labelled diagnostic seed, unlocked before the native warmup; July clear sky melts it naturally. Native VP9/Opus canvas8fps plus the actual post-limiter audio bus; indexed by packet-copy only. SwiftShader capture timings are not physical GPU performance.
